description: This bar chart illustrates the number of samples for various input and output configurations, with the vertical axis labeled “Number” and scaled linearly from 0 to 120,000, and the horizontal axis displaying six distinct categories corresponding to different input/output sizes: “2K-Input”, “4K-Input”, “8K-Input”, “16K-Input”, “4K-Output”, “8K-Output”, and “16K-Output”. The bars are grouped by input/output type, with input categories (“2K-Input”, “4K-Input”, “8K-Input”, “16K-Input”) appearing first, followed by their respective output categories (“4K-Output”, “8K-Output”, “16K-Output”) immediately after each input bar, forming a grouped bar chart structure. Each bar is uniquely colored and patterned for visual distinction: “2K-Input” is yellow with diagonal stripes and has a value of 9,320; “4K-Input” is solid salmon pink with diagonal stripes and has a value of 3,784; “8K-Input” is light blue with diagonal stripes and has a value of 1,401; “16K-Input” is dark blue with diagonal stripes and has a value of 832; “4K-Output” is solid salmon pink with diagonal stripes and has a value of 108,494; “8K-Output” is light blue with diagonal stripes and has a value of 17,865; and “16K-Output” is dark blue with diagonal stripes and has a value of 4,247. The bars are not sorted by height, and none are visually emphasized with shading, bolding, or annotations beyond their labeled values.
